== Ingredients ==
* 1 container (4.5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) hickory smoke-flavored albacore tuna
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* Juice of 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] wedge
* 4 slices white [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
* 2 slices smoked [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine tuna, melted butter, and lemon juice.
#Spread some of the tuna mixture on each slice of bread. Top with cheese.
#[[Cookbook:Broiling|Broil]] until the cheese is melted.
